title: October 18–24. Doctrine and Covenants 121–123: “O God, Where Art Thou?”
book: Come, Follow Me 2021: Doctrine and Covenants

Joseph and his companions were arrested on October 31, 1838, and kept under heavy guard day and night. After a preliminary trial in Richmond, Missouri, they were taken to Liberty Jail on December 1.
